summary: Diarization in this re-transcription is poor: letters D, G and H each merge several voices (Damian Penner/Jake Hiebert/Zwaagstra on D; Resident 3/KodaGo delegate/Siemens/Susan Penner on G; Siemens/Bill Hiebert/Zwaagstra/delegate on H), handled with 47 overrides and 11 splits. Jake vs Bill Hiebert turns rest on minutes seconder order and pitch (Jake ~106-111 Hz, Bill ~138-151 Hz) and should be checked by ear.
